cards.answer: Wukong is a fighter with AD-scaling physical damage. He dashes into enemies, uses an attacking clone and spins to knock enemies up. Fighting champions or monsters builds his armor and health regeneration.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance, avoid clustering and disengage when he builds durability.

cards.answer: Stone Skin grants bonus armor and health regeneration based on Wukong's maximum health. Damage from Wukong or his clone against champions or monsters stacks up these benefits.
cards.counterplay: Avoid prolonged trades while his defenses build; disengage to let the stacks fade.

citations.quote: Wukong gains bonus armor based on level and health regeneration equal to a portion of his maximum health.

facts.claim: Stone Skin grants bonus armor and health regeneration based on Wukong's maximum health.

For each stack, Wukong increases the bonus armor and health regeneration gained.

facts.claim: Damage from Wukong or his clone against champions or monsters stacks up these benefits.

cards.priority_reason: Explains why extended combat increases his durability.

cards.answer: Crushing Blow empowers his next basic attack with extra range, bonus physical damage and temporary armor reduction. Damage dealt by Wukong or his clone reduces its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Respect the extra attack reach and back away while your armor is reduced.

citations.quote: Wukong's next basic attack within a few seconds will gain bonus range, deal bonus physical damage, and inflict armor reduction for a short time.

cards.priority_reason: Its reach and armor reduction strengthen his follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: Warrior Trickster briefly makes Wukong invisible and dashes him away, leaving an attacking clone at his starting position. The clone deals reduced damage, can copy Crushing Blow, benefits from Nimbus Strike's attack speed and casts Cyclone when Wukong does.
cards.counterplay: Avoid committing attacks to the clone and keep clear of its spinning attacks.

citations.quote: The clone deals reduced damage.

facts.claim: The clone deals reduced damage, can copy Crushing Blow, benefits from Nimbus Strike's attack speed and casts Cyclone when Wukong does.

cards.priority_reason: The invisible reposition and damaging clone affect targeting and threat coverage.

cards.answer: Nimbus Strike dashes Wukong to an enemy and strikes nearby additional enemies with magic damage. On arrival, he gains temporary bonus attack speed.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from his dash reach and avoid clustering around his target; disengage from his faster follow-up attacks.

citations.quote: Wukong dashes to the target enemy's location and sends out untargetable clones to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing magic damage.

facts.claim: On arrival, he gains temporary bonus attack speed.

cards.priority_reason: His targeted gap closer starts close-range pressure.

cards.answer: Cyclone makes Wukong spin with bonus movement speed, repeatedly dealing physical damage based on enemies' maximum health and knocking them up. He can cast another Cyclone after the initial spin ends, threatening another knockup.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and move away from the spin; remain cautious after it ends.

citations.quote: Wukong spins his staff around for a short time, becoming ghosted and gaining bonus movement speed.
The staff continually deals physical damage to enemies hit based on their maximum health, and can briefly knock them up once.
